d: PC version of Silent Hill 3 ported to PS Vita, restoring PS2 features with 30 FPS, 16:9 support, PS2 sound pitch and an improved puzzle cursor.
ld:
Silent Hill 3 Enhanced Edition brings the Windows PC version of Silent Hill 3 to the PlayStation Vita through static recompilation.

The project aims to restore features and details from the original PlayStation 2 version while adapting the experience to the Vita hardware.

Features:

- 30 FPS gameplay.
- 16:9 widescreen support.
- PS2 sound pitch restored.
- Functional puzzle cursor adapted for PS Vita controls.
- Original PC game data is used to run the port.

Requirements:

- PlayStation Vita with a compatible custom firmware setup.
- libshacccg.suprx.
- Original Windows PC copy of Silent Hill 3.
- sh3prep to prepare the required game data.

Installation:

Install the VPK using VitaShell. Download the Game Data archive and extract it directly into ux0:data/.

The archive already contains the sh3 folder, so the final directory must be ux0:data/sh3/.

Bring your own copy of the original game. The VPK and data archive are provided separately.
